_readme: Reviewed manual corrections for foreign issuers' Form 4 lines (api/_lib/fpiNormalize.js). Keyed by ticker. ratio = home-market shares per ONE US-listed security; cur = the currency the issuer's insiders report in. An entry fills in only when the SEC documents (F-6 / 20-F) and the market-derived ratio give nothing; add "force": true to make it win over them. Always cite the source.
